### The Greater Pentecost
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-greater-pentecost
Passage: Acts 2:1-13
Points:
- Pentecost recalls Mount Sinai, where God originally revealed His presence through wind, fire, and the giving of the law.
- In contrast to Sinai and the tabernacle, where believers were kept at a distance, the Holy Spirit rested directly upon the disciples without consuming them.
- The Holy Spirit equips and transforms believers internally so they can obey God's commands.
- The manifest presence of God empowers the church to overcome fear and boldly take the gospel into the world.

### Fiery Faith
Author: Sarah Jennings
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-june-1-2009-11604170.html
Passage: Acts 2:2-4
Points:
- The arrival of the Holy Spirit with wind and fire marked the dramatic birth of the early church.
- The disciples wrestled with human weakness, uncertainty, and fear prior to the Spirit's arrival.
- God does not wait for people to achieve perfection before filling them with His presence and power.
- Christians are encouraged to reflect on moments of spiritual vitality and ask God to rekindle that inner fire.
